headword: {日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}

definitions.explanation: Japan's present constitution, promulgated on November 3, 1946 and in force since May 3, 1947. It made the people sovereign, guarantees basic human rights, and in Article 9 renounces war. It has never been amended.

examples.japanese: {日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{読|よ}んだ→読む：00426_yomu⟧。
examples.english: I read the Constitution of Japan.

examples.japanese: {日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧1947⟦{年|ねん}→年：09876_nen⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{施行|しこう}→施行：06581_shikou⟧⟦された→する：00392_suru⟧。
examples.english: The Constitution of Japan came into force in 1947.

examples.japanese: {日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{三大原則|さんだいげんそく}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧、{国民主権|こくみんしゅけん}、{基本的人権|きほんてきじんけん}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{尊重|そんちょう}→尊重：03327_sonchou⟧、⟦{平和主義|へいわしゅぎ}→平和主義：31402_heiwashugi⟧だ。
examples.english: The three basic principles of the Constitution of Japan are popular sovereignty, respect for fundamental human rights, and pacifism.

notes:
In everyday speech it is simply ⟦{憲法|けんぽう}→憲法：02744_kenpou⟧. It replaced the prewar {大日本帝国憲法|だいにっぽんていこくけんぽう} (the Meiji Constitution).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- {日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}{第九条|だいきゅうじょう}: Article 9 of the Constitution (renunciation of war)
- {日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{前文|ぜんぶん}→前文：21506_zenbun⟧: the preamble of the Constitution
- {日本国憲法|にほんこくけんぽう}⟦を→を：00422_wo⟧⟦{改正|かいせい}→改正：00446_kaisei⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧: to amend the Constitution

CULTURAL NOTE:
May 3, the day it took effect, is the national holiday {憲法記念日|けんぽうきねんび} (Constitution Memorial Day). Whether to amend it, especially Article 9, is a long-running political debate.
